:::{#sol-cross-entropy-infinite-expectation}

By @def-cross-entropy, $\crossentropyf{p}{q} = \infty$.
Also $-\log q_X \ge 0$ always, and $-\log q_X = \infty$ with [probability](probability-basics.qmd#def-probability) at least $p_k > 0$,
so $\E{-\log q_X} = \infty$ as well.
Both are infinite, so they are still equal.

:::
